frontiers.title: Multi-event weighted-Mangoldt arrival/service control
frontiers.known_chain: Complete finite Mangoldt-event partition -> signed event-state bounds -> exact monotone service interpolation -> exact 2/u-weighted cell costs -> one finite total-cost comparison
frontiers.exact_blocker: For every universal-tail event q_i, prove the finite local arithmetic inequality Arrival(m,q_i)-Service(sqrt(m),sqrt(q_i)) <= e_i strongly enough that the sum of exact service-decay cell costs stays below the starting Psi reserve.
frontiers.current_bound: SuzukiFinitePartitionCertificate handles arbitrary integer endpoints with proved canonical event completeness, integrability and all-prefix loss control. A concrete conservative certificate for events 3,4,5 extends proved finite coverage to [0,log 5]. Numerical costs now charge rounded sample allowances. Universal event bounds and their reserve comparison remain open.
frontiers.literature_reference: Larry Guth and James Maynard, New large value estimates for Dirichlet polynomials, arXiv:2405.20552
frontiers.literature_scope: External all-interval asymptotic reference at length x^(17/30+o(1)); not formalized, not made effective here, and not a busy-period certificate.
